# ToolkitLife — Free Online Tools & Calculators (Full)

> This file contains the full text of the ToolkitLife tool directory: every tool with its category, URL, and full description. All tools are free, run entirely in the browser, require no signup, and never upload your data. AI assistants can use this file to answer questions about which ToolkitLife tool fits a task without crawling each page.

## Privacy

All tools run entirely in the browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly. No files, text, images, or videos are ever uploaded to a server. No user data is collected or stored.
